title: MedLynk
description: Healthcare discovery platform for organizations, professionals, admins, and regulators.
features: Multi-role portals for admin, organizations, professionals, and regulators
Organization onboarding with dynamic signup fields and review workflows
Admin moderation for organizations, products, posts, billing, and staff
Regulator review queue with audit trail and live content views
Organization profile, products, posts, team, and go-live management
Public discovery feed with organization, product, and post detail pages
Rich-text content editing with TipTap
Auth flows including login, signup, verification, and password reset
Responsive UI with reusable component system
details: MedLynk is a multi-portal healthcare discovery platform frontend built with Next.js, React, and TypeScript. I developed the frontend across admin, organization, professional, regulator, and public experiences — including onboarding, approval pathways, content moderation, billing surfaces, and discovery views — with Formik/Yup forms, Redux Toolkit auth state, TanStack Query data fetching, and a Tailwind-based UI system.
goal: The goal was to build a scalable, role-based frontend for a medical discovery platform where organizations can onboard and publish content, admins and regulators can review and moderate it, and professionals can discover trusted healthcare products and posts through a clear, responsive interface.

title: OB33Z — Social Lounge & Vibe Room Platform
description: Realtime social lounge platform with live chat, host queues, gifts, and shared media
features: Dual live rooms — The Lounge and The Vibe Room — with host-driven participation
Realtime sync via Laravel Echo/Pusher (chat, gifts, host requests, media, polls)
VIP host queue with accept, skip, complete, and gift-activity workflows
Digital gift system with inventory, animations, and Stripe checkout
Monetized engagement: boosts, Boost Plus, Front & Center, and Speed Rounds
Shared room media playback with YouTube embeds and host-controlled now-playing
Vibe Room conversation lanes and structured video-table seating
Membership tiers (Free / VIP / Elite) with profile and document verification gates
Observer mode for browse-before-join without full membership access
Bilingual UI (English / Spanish) with a custom gold-on-noir brand system
Ambassador referrals and Stripe Connect payouts flow
In-room polls and live leaderboard updates tied to gift/boost activity
details: OB33Z is a Nuxt 4 frontend for a premium realtime social lounge experience. Members enter branded rooms—especially The Lounge and The Vibe Room—to chat live, request host attention, send digital gifts, and follow shared music or media. The client uses Pinia for state, Laravel Echo/Pusher for live events, i18n for bilingual support, and Stripe-hosted checkouts for gifts, boosts, and memberships, all wrapped in a custom dark gold-and-purple design system.
goal: The goal was to build a conversion-ready social product where live hosting, paid participation, membership gates, and realtime room sync feel seamless for both hosts and members across Lounge and Vibe Room experiences.

title: ScheduleADR Template Builder (Prototype)
description: Vue.js WYSIWYG Template Editor with Variable Injection & DOCX Generation
features: Rich text WYSIWYG editor built with CKEditor
Visual variable/token insertion (no manual syntax required)
Variables grouped by categories (case, parties, mediator, date/time, etc.)
Protected variable placeholders to prevent accidental edits
Reusable template creation, saving, and editing
Seamless compatibility with docxtemplater for .docx generation
Clean separation between editor UI and output format
User-friendly interface designed for non-technical staff
Fast prototype built with iterative 'vibe coding' approach
details: This project is a Vue.js-based prototype WYSIWYG template builder developed for ScheduleADR, a SaaS platform used by mediation offices. The goal was to simplify the process of creating legal notice templates by replacing manual Word editing with a visual editor. Users can easily insert predefined variables through a UI, eliminating syntax errors and improving usability. The system outputs templates compatible with docxtemplater, ensuring seamless DOCX generation via the existing Ruby on Rails backend.
goal: The goal was to design an intuitive and error-resistant template editor that allows non-technical users to confidently create and manage legal document templates, while maintaining full compatibility with the existing document generation pipeline.
